modules.text:
A bold packaging system for three distinctive flavors

This packaging design brings ZERODAM’s three low-sugar tteokbokki flavors—Sweet & Spicy, Pepper & Spicy, and Creamy & Rich—together through a shared visual system. Bold typography, appetizing food imagery, and distinct flavor colors communicate the product’s key features while giving each variety its own personality.

modules.text:
Bold type. Three flavors.

The design highlights the product’s low-sugar appeal while preserving the rich, appetizing character of tteokbokki.
Vibrant Korean typography stands against a white background, layered with expressive English lettering to introduce movement within a structured layout. All three flavors share the same composition, with colors and ingredient imagery distinguishing each variety.

modules.text:
One layout, three distinct personalities

Sweet & Spicy
Vivid red typography and chili imagery capture the lively character of the sweet and spicy flavor. Glossy red sauce and generous food imagery create an appetizing focal point.

Pepper & Spicy
Cobalt blue typography and a pepper shaker illustration emphasize the flavor’s distinctive character. The contrast between the blue lettering and red tteokbokki creates a striking visual impression.

Creamy & Rich
Mint typography and a cream pitcher illustration convey the smooth character of the cream flavor. The light-colored sauce blends naturally with the white background for a soft, balanced composition.

modules.text:
Typography meets food imagery

Bold Korean Typography
The product name takes center stage, making “Low-Sugar Tteokbokki” the first message viewers encounter.

Expressive Script
English flavor names overlap the Korean typography, pairing solid letterforms with fluid, expressive strokes.

Appetizing Food Graphics
Tteokbokki, a fork, and a plate come together to evoke the moment of taking a bite. Chili, pepper, and cream imagery provide visual cues to each flavor.

Information Badges
Sugar and calorie information is grouped into compact badges, keeping it easy to find and clearly separated from the main imagery.

modules.text:
SEA YA BABY — Swim, Glow, Repeat.

SEA YA BABY는 Y2K 서프 감성을 뷰티와 비치 액세서리로 연결한 여름 라이프스타일 콘셉트 브랜드입니다. 서핑보드, 히비스커스, 조개, 쪼리 등 익숙한 여름의 오브젝트를 제품의 형태로 재해석하고, 이를 비치백과 텍스타일로 확장했습니다.
“See ya, baby!”라는 가벼운 인사에 바다를 뜻하는 “SEA”를 더한 이름으로, 즐거웠던 여름을 끝내기보다 다음 만남으로 이어가는 마음을 담았습니다.


SEA YA BABY is a summer lifestyle concept brand that brings Y2K surf culture into beauty and beach accessories. Familiar summer objects — a surfboard, a hibiscus, a seashell, a flip-flop — are reshaped into the products themselves, then extended into bags and textiles.

Bold, flowing lettering paired with a hibiscus. The SYB monogram carries the brand on charms, labels and cap patches.

modules.text:
This packaging design reinterprets MONCHHICHI’s warm and lovable character through the bright, playful world of fruit jelly.

Vivid colors and abundant fruit imagery were used to communicate the distinct apple and strawberry flavors at a glance, while MONCHHICHI’s friendly charm was incorporated throughout the design. A key feature of the packaging is the heart-shaped composition: when the two products are placed side by side, their individual graphics connect to form a complete heart. Each package maintains its own identity, while together they create one cohesive visual story.

modules.text:
RAW GREEN — From Soil to Skin.

흙에서 자란 원물의 생명력과 자연 그대로의 질감을 바디케어 제품에 담은 비건 바디케어 브랜드, RAW GREEN을 기획했습니다. 당근, 오이, 가지, 토마토, 감자, 비트 총 6가지 채소에서 영감을 받아 각 원물의 컬러와 질감이 드러나는 슈가 바디 스크럽과 솝 바 라인을 디자인했습니다.

RAW GREEN is a vegan body care brand inspired by the vitality, colours and raw textures of vegetables grown in the soil — six sugar body scrubs and soap bars from carrot, cucumber, eggplant, tomato, potato and beet.

images.alt: packaging design branding  brand identity vegan skincare 브랜딩 패키지디자인 visual identity art direction  그래픽디자인

modules.text:
‘raw’는 갓 뽑아낸 뿌리처럼 흐르는 손글씨 형태로, ‘green’은 단단한 채소처럼 묵직한 형태로 대비를 주어 가공되지 않은 원물과 건강한 결과물을 
한 단어 안에 담았습니다.

“raw” flows like a freshly pulled root; “green” stands firm like fresh produce.

Six vegetable colours taken straight from the produce, held together by Leaf Green and Harvest Cream.

modules.text:
솝 바는 채소의 형태를 그대로 옮겨 ‘바 자체가 채소’가 되도록 디자인했습니다. 스크럽은 내용물이 그대로 보이는 투명 스파우트 파우치에 담아, 원물의 컬러와 입자가 곧 패키지가 되도록 했으며 생분해성 플라스틱 소재를 적용하는 방향으로 기획했습니다.

The soap bar is the vegetable. The clear, biodegradable spout pouch lets the colour and grain of each scrub 
become the packaging itself.
